title: DAY 31/90
FLUID MECHANICS
scenes.voice: Day thirty one of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge. Seventy five days to go. A new week starts with momentum, flow measurement and dimensional analysis.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Subject, fluid mechanics. Today's topic links Bernoulli from last week to real devices: forces from jets, flow meters, and model testing.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover the momentum and energy equations, venturi and orifice meters, the pitot tube, and dimensional analysis with Buckingham's pi theorem.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Number of pi terms equals variables minus fundamental dimensions. A venturi's discharge coefficient is near zero point nine eight, an orifice's only about zero point six two.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Grab the practice PDF on Telegram now. Test from seven to nine P. M.: use the link in our Telegram channel, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 30 Toppers
scenes.voice: Week five revision toppers! Sweta Rani Sahoo tops with twenty eight out of thirty, Rajeev Kumar is second, and Lokesh Gautam third. Congratulations!
